headlines.headline: GRIZZLIES WAIVE D'ANGELO RUSSELL IN ROSTER CRUNCH AHEAD OF CAMP
headlines.detail: Memphis waived D'Angelo Russell Friday with 19 players on standard deals against a 15-man limit. Dallas held media day previewing a Kyrie Irving-Cooper Flagg pairing; camps open league-wide September 29.

headlines.headline: QB INJURY WAVE RESHAPES WEEK 3 AS DANIELS, DART SIDELINED
headlines.detail: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels (redislocated elbow) is out Sunday vs. Seattle, with Marcus Mariota starting; Jaxson Dart's injury has Jameis Winston back under center for the Giants.

headlines.headline: NO. 1 TEXAS AT NO. 14 TENNESSEE HEADLINES STACKED WEEK 4 SATURDAY
headlines.detail: Week 4 opened Friday night with No. 5 Indiana hosting Northwestern, before Saturday's slate: Texas at Tennessee, No. 4 Ole Miss at No. 21 Florida, and Colorado at Baylor.

headlines.headline: NEVADA'S STEVE ALFORD TO RETIRE AS ELIGIBILITY AND INJURY NEWS PILE UP
headlines.detail: Alford will retire at season's end after 36 years coaching. Roddy Gayle Jr. won a fifth year of eligibility in court; Michigan freshman Brandon McCoy Jr. tore his ACL in an exhibition game.
